name: Effective Range / Monotonic Projected Minimum Teaching Set Size
proof: Let \(\mathcal G\subseteq\mathcal H\) and let \(\pi_T(\mathcal G)\) be any coordinate projection. Its effective range is contained in that of \(\mathcal H\), and the labels on its active coordinates distinguish every target trace from every other trace. Hence its minimum teaching-set size is at most \(\mathrm E(\mathcal H)\). Maximizing first over projections and then over subfamilies gives \(\mathrm{TS}_{\min}^{*p}(\mathcal H)\le\mathrm E(\mathcal H)\).
